cluster_stories.title: Nvidia Nears $14 Billion Hugging Face Deal | Bloomberg Tech 09/02/2026
cluster_stories.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Nvidia's advanced talks to acquire AI startup Hugging Face in a $14 billion deal. Plus, Dell shares jump after the company boosted its annual sales forecast by $25 billion due to surging demand for servers to run AI tasks. And, Uber cuts 10% of its staff globally to streamline its core engineering, science, and delivery groups. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA NEARS $14B HUGGING FACE ACQUISITION

cluster_stories.title: Nvidia In Advanced Talks for Hugging Face
cluster_stories.summary: Nvidia could be closing in on its biggest AI acquisition yet, according to sources. The chipmaker is in advanced talks to buy Hugging Face in a deal that could be worth about $14 billion. Bloomberg's Ian King and Rachel Metz join Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech" to discuss their reporting. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA IN ADVANCED TALKS FOR $14B HUGGING FACE BUY

cluster_stories.title: Nvidia May Be Close to $14 Billion Deal for Hugging Face
cluster_stories.summary: Nvidia is in advanced talks to acquire artificial intelligence startup Hugging Face in a transaction that may total about $14 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Matt Bloxham has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA IN $14B HUGGING FACE DEAL... ADVANCED TALKS
